releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.33 adds Library as the fifth main tab and moves Settings to a gear. Share video links from YouTube, TikTok or Facebook, ordinary web links, or selected text from Android apps into a local Smart Life Library with search, type filters, editable title, topic and note. Video shares are saved as references to their original links, not downloaded video files; shared files and images continue to use Inbox. Price Photos can now link a product to one saved Library guide without duplicating the Library item. The lightweight OCR pause, Notes spelling recovery, Inbox decision flow and category management remain preserved.
